lines.text: سرایان و کساد پیرایه و افتادن یتیمند و عطارد بافت اشجار و اثمار و تنگی خلق و ارزانی پنبه
lines.en: singers, and the dullness of ornaments, and the falling of orphans. And Mercury [indicates] the blight of trees and fruits, and the narrowness of disposition, and the cheapness of cotton.

lines.text: و کتان (احکام وبال عطارد) دلالت کند بر نکبت و ضعف حال عمال و اهل قلم و دیوانیان و اخبار
lines.en: and linen. (Judgments of the detriment of Mercury) It indicates the misfortune and weakness of condition of agents, and people of the pen, and bureaucrats, and news

lines.text: دروغ و جستن بادها معتدل و خطا در معالجات و تدبیرات و بیماری عامه و بستگی کارها و تاخیر
lines.en: lies, and the blowing of moderate winds, and error in treatments and managements, and general illness, and the tying up of affairs, and the delay

lines.text: مهمات اهل حرفه (احکام وبال قمر) دلالت کند بر بیماری و فساد حیوانات ابی و سرگردانی
lines.en: of the important matters of the people of trades. (Judgments of the detriment of the Moon) It indicates illness and the corruption of aquatic animals, and the wandering

lines.text: فوج و جواسیس و نقصان ابها و تفرقه مسافران و زحمت زنان و مسافران دختران (فصل
lines.en: of troops and spies, and the decrease of waters, and the scattering of travelers, and the trouble of women, and the traveling of girls. (Section

lines.text: سیم در احکام اوج و حضیض کواکب اوج زحل) دلالت کند بر صلاح احوال رؤسا و
lines.en: three on the judgments of the apogee and perigee of the planets. The apogee of Saturn) indicates the goodness of the conditions of chiefs and

lines.text: احشام و قری و اهل حرث و زراعت و کثرت فواید و طیب قلوب اکراد و اهل جبال (احکام اوج
lines.en: retinues, and villages, and people of tillage and agriculture, and the abundance of benefits, and the goodness of hearts of Kurds and people of the mountains. (Judgments of the apogee

lines.text: مشتری دلالت کند بر صلاح حال قضاة و اهل دین و علما و فضلا (احکام اوج مریخ) دلالت
lines.en: of Jupiter) indicates the goodness of condition of judges, and people of religion, and scholars, and the learned. (Judgments of the apogee of Mars) indicates

lines.text: کند بر طیب قلوب امرا و اخیار و کثرت فوائد ایشان و قسمت الات حرب بر سپاهیان (احکام
lines.en: the goodness of hearts of commanders and the good, and the abundance of their benefits, and the distribution of instruments of war to soldiers. (Judgments

lines.text: اوج شمس) دلالت کند بر قوت ملوك و جمع شدن اتراك و گرمی هوا و شدت کرب (احکام اوج
lines.en: of the apogee of the Sun) indicates the strength of kings, and the gathering of Turks, and the heat of the air, and the intensity of distress. (Judgments of the apogee

lines.text: زهره) دلالت کند بر صلاح احوال کتاب و وزرا و اهل قلم و متصرفان و تحویلداران و احکام
lines.en: of Venus) indicates the goodness of conditions of scribes, and viziers, and people of the pen, and administrators, and cashiers. And the judgments

lines.text: حضیض ضد احکام اوج بود قیاس باید نمود والله اعلم واحکم (تنبیه) اصحاب کتاب اخوان الصفا
lines.en: of the perigee are the opposite of the judgments of the apogee; one must deduce by analogy, and God is most knowing and most judging. (Warning) The authors of the book Ikhwan al-Safa

lines.text: هر يك از کواکب را در احوالی که عارض ایشان میشود تشبیه بچیزی کرده اند که در فن احکام
lines.en: have likened each of the planets in the conditions that occur to them to something that is involved in the art of judgments.

lines.text: دخیل است و طالبانرا بسیار مفید و ان چنانست که گویند از میانه کواکب شمس مثل پادشاه است
lines.en: And it is very useful for seekers. And it is such that they say: among the planets, the Sun is like a king,

lines.text: و سایر انجم مثل جنود و اعوان و انصار و قمر مثل شاهزاده و ولی عهد و عطارد مثل مستوفی
lines.en: and the other stars are like troops, and helpers, and supporters. And the Moon is like a prince and crown prince. And Mercury is like an auditor

lines.text: و کاتب و مریخ مثل سپهسالار و صاحب جیش و مشتری مثل وزیر و قاضی و اهل فتوی و زحل
lines.en: and scribe. And Mars is like a commander-in-chief and master of the army. And Jupiter is like a vizier, and judge, and people of fatwa. And Saturn

lines.text: صاحب خزائن و زهره مثل خواتین و خدم و افلاك مر این کواکب را مثل اقالیم و بروج مثل
lines.en: is the master of treasuries. And Venus is like ladies and servants. And the spheres for these planets are like climes, and the signs are like

lines.text: ولایات و حدود و وجوه مثل مدن و قصبات و درجات مثل قراء و دقائق مثل محلات و اسوا
lines.en: provinces, and the terms and faces are like cities and towns, and the degrees are like villages, and the minutes are like neighborhoods and markets,

lines.text: و ثوانی مثل منازل و کواکب در درجات خود مثل ارواحند در اجساد و کوکب در خانه خود مثل
lines.en: and the seconds are like houses. And the planets in their degrees are like souls in bodies. And a planet in its own house is like

lines.text: شخصی است در شهر خود و در هبوط مثل شخصی است که جزو و بی اعتبار شده است و در حضیض
lines.en: a person in his own city. And in fall, it is like a person who has become a part and discredited. And in perigee,

lines.text: مثل شخصی است که از مرتبه خود ساقط شده باشد و در تحت الشعاع مثل شخصی است محبوس و
lines.en: it is like a person who has fallen from his rank. And under the rays, it is like a person imprisoned. And

lines.text: در احتراق مثل شخصی است مریض و مشرف بر هلاك و در اقامت مثل متحیر و در رجعت مثل
lines.en: in combustion, it is like a person sick and on the verge of ruin. And in station, it is like one bewildered. And in retrograde, it is like

lines.text: شخصی است که از مطلب خود بازمانده باشد و در سرعت سیر مثل شخصی است مقبل و
lines.en: a person who has been held back from his goal. And in swiftness of motion, it is like a person advancing and

Judgments of the apogee of the planets

summary.headline: Planetary Detriments and Apogees
summary.text: Judgments of Mercury’s and the Moon’s detriment, followed by Section Three on the apogee and perigee of the planets, including effects for Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, and Venus. A warning cites Ikhwan al-Safa’s correspondence between planets, social roles, celestial divisions, and planetary conditions such as fall, combustion, station, and retrograde motion.
